MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 by and between Kumasi Cloud
Services Ltd, a company registered in Ghana (the "Provider"), and
Northstar Studio Limited (the "Client").

1. Term. This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for a
term of twelve (12) months. It shall renew automatically for successive
one-year terms unless either party gives sixty (60) days' written notice.

2. Fees. The Client shall pay a total contract value of GHS 18,000.00 in
twelve monthly instalments.

3. Governing law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Ghana.
